text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...A total defeat. There's not an excuse to be made—
I didn't show a single good moment out there."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Calling myself a queen with running like this is an absolute joke.
It's truly pathetic...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Spending any more time moping around would just be a waste, right?
Instead, let's talk about what comes next!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Not at all, you know? I'm genuinely frustrated and pathetic—I feel like screaming my lungs out."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: “Still, that is not how a queen conducts herself.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Even if you suffer a disgraceful defeat on the track, you must at least conduct yourself with noble grace."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So, comfort is a no thank you.
I won't show you any tears or screams.
Even if it's you, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, shall we start by
analyzing today's defeat?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's a bitter defeat, as long as you
find something to take away from it, it won't be in vain!"
choice_data_list: Your strong heart and pride are really reassuring.
Next time, show them queenly racing too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you! But next time,
I'm definitely bringing home a win."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you I'm a queen on the track, too,
and put your mind completely at ease♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes, a true Queen is defined by strength.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I'll prove to everyone that I'm not just all talk and good looks!
